# casync / fuzz-compress

casync's own fuzz target `fuzz-compress` ([source](source/fuzz-compress.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over casync (systemd/casync at b4b7e560).

24-byte header picks the compression alg; compressor_start_decode/compressor_input/compressor_decode into a MAX(size,128)-byte buffer; every error is log_debug_errno + return 0 and the decoded bytes are never inspected.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against casync at commit b4b7e560 with 5 patches to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch casync` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz-compress.plain` | 321,688 | `f3b134d43c60b5013b966c0d2f0134bae02109feb309c08037521fe4e1ad15ab` |
| ubsan | `fuzz-compress.ubsan` | 321,840 | `7661345deb8dc5854809b2ea2fe2a5cfa1c51246f157f07de912ab48ae57d9d0` |
| asan | `fuzz-compress.asan` | 853,048 | `7bdf529a08252568ba52657b01bc2f10188f8680186261656d69898394d6e575` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz-compress.asan-ubsan` | 853,016 | `ad8dc339b3e2500c457cd372b4b5784f1c10c9f78046c33591eb4c31156ae527` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
